snippet.title: Croc's World 5 Trailer
snippet.description:
Croc’s World 5 launches on Nintendo Switch on October 15 and on PlayStation 4 on October 16, 2026 — an Xbox version follows in November. A free demo is already available in the Nintendo eShop.

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/crocs-world-5-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020764/

Croc’s fifth adventure is a classic 2D platformer in the spirit of the great console and home computer games of the 80s and 90s: easy to pick up, challenging to master, and fun for players of every age. Run, jump and swim through 60 hand-crafted levels across four islands — swamps, ancient Greece, Egypt and the world of the Maya.

New in this entry:
– Gravity zones: Croc simply keeps running along the ceiling
– Level sections that are constantly on the move, so every jump has to be timed

Also in the game:
– 60 levels across 4 islands, each island ending in a boss fight
– Up to 3 stars to collect in every level, some hidden off the beaten path
– Optional retro mode with a CRT screen effect
– 10 achievements to unlock
– Vastly improved graphics over the previous entries

Developed and published by Sprakelsoft GmbH

#CrocsWorld #NintendoSwitch #indiegame #Playstation #Xbox
